views.name: focused_whole_view
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  P.id
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
  ON P.player_fifa_api_id = PA.player_fifa_api_id
ORDER BY
  PA.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1
views.description:
Task: Identify the player with the maximum overall rating and return their API ID.
Required outputs: The API ID of the player with the highest overall rating.
counter_examples: What is the height of the tallest player? Indicate his name.
What is the preferred foot when attacking of the player with the lowest potential?
Among the players with an overall rating between 60 to 65, how many players whose going to be in all of your attack moves instead of defensing?
Who are the top 5 players who perform better in crossing actions? Indicate their player id.
